issues.desc: background.md and the title use the acronym "GLMM" without spelling it out anywhere in the document. Key Insights writes "GLMM (arm fixed; task/scenario/seed random)" but never expands it to Generalized Linear Mixed Model, leaving a standalone reader unable to decode the term from this file alone.

background.md refers to "infra-(a) piece 5" without explaining what the "(a)" qualifier means (e.g., infra-(a) vs infra-(b) distinction). A new reader cannot determine the scope of the infra sub-program from this file alone.

CHK-003 context uses hypothesis labels "H1" and "H2" (e.g., "H1 section-6 not-amplified; H2 section-5 completion") without local definition. They refer to pre-reg hypotheses, but a reader of only the checklist would not know what H1/H2 stand for without reading lattice-experiment-protocol.md.

Arm names A4, A2prime (A2′), A1, A2, A3 appear throughout the background and checklist with no local definition of what each arm represents (e.g., A4=Lattice loop, A2prime=compute-matched naive). A standalone reader must consult the external pre-reg doc to decode them.
